Name: Blurry's Abigail and Haley Portraits
Author: bluerrycherry
Description:
Back in 2022, I tried to do some custom portraits for some of the bachelors and bachelorettes that I got burnt out from, but I'm back again! Feel free to try it out, and feedback is appreciated! Abigail and Haley are completed

This mode requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] 
[b]
[/b]How to Install:
1. Extract Portraiture and place them inside the mods folder
2. Extract my protrait files and place them inside the Portraits folder inside of the Portraiture folder (Mods < Portraiture < Portraits)
3. When talking to an NPC, press 'P' to toggle your portraits
